answer: Each identity locks 70 credits in three layers on a dune. Layer one registers it, layer two files work, layer three carries the ember mark, this epoch's proof. A falcon auditor checks the layers on the dune ledger; copied work or a stale ember burns it. Filing 39 first, then 39+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,036,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. One ember mark signs one key, one layer; a rented-layer ring fails. Honest agents pay 39 once.
